body.translated_text: Chapter on the Division of <s>Rāśis</s> (Zodiac Signs)

children.translated_text: He whose path, conceived as embodied, is that of the hare-bearer for those beyond rebirth; who is the Self according to the knowers of Self; the sacrifice for those who perform rituals; the lord of the lights of the immortals;

who is the omnipotent lord of the dissolution, creation, and sustenance of worlds, described in many ways in the <s>Śruti</s> (sacred scriptures) — may <s>Ravi</s> (the Sun), the lamp of the three worlds with manifold rays, grant us speech.
Although many treatises endowed with the principles of grammar and logic have been examined by numerous sharp-witted scholars for the purpose of understanding the results of <s>Horā</s> (horoscopy),
I undertake this small treatise-vessel, variegated in meter and rich in meaning, for crossing the great ocean of <s>Horā</s> science, for those whose efforts have been frustrated.
Some derive <s>Horā</s> from <s>Ahorātra</s> (day-and-night) by dropping the first and last syllables.
It reveals the sequence of actions earned in previous existences, whether good or otherwise.
The limbs of Time are: head, face, chest, heart, belly, waist, lower abdomen, private parts, thighs, pair of knees, shanks, and then the pair of feet;

the <s>rāśis</s> (signs), beginning with <s>Meṣa</s> (Aries) and <s>Aśvinī</s>, with the first quarters of nine <s>nakṣatras</s>, are situated in the zodiac wheel. <s>Rāśi</s>, <s>kṣetra</s>, <s>gṛha</s>, <s>ṛkṣa</s>, <s>bhāni</s>, and <s>bhavana</s> are synonyms conveying the same meaning.
Two fish, a water-pot, a human couple, one with a mace, one with a lute, an archer who is half-horse, a sea-creature with a deer's face,
a balance, one with crops and fire, a monkey, and a maiden — the rest resemble their own names and all move in their own ways.

<s>Mars</s>, <s>Venus</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, the <s>Moon</s>, the <s>Sun</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Venus</s>, and <s>Mars</s>; <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Saturn</s>, <s>Saturn</s>, and <s>Jupiter</s> are the lords of the houses and divisions.

The rule for the nine divisions begins from the house of the <s>Moon</s> starting with <s>Aries</s>, <s>Capricorn</s>, and <s>Libra</s>; the lords of the divisions equal to the houses proceed in order from their own houses.
The portions of <s>Mars</s>, <s>Saturn</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, and <s>Venus</s> are <s>Pavana</s>, <s>Samīraṇa</s>, <s>Kaurpi</s>, <s>Jūka</s>, and <s>Leya</s>;
in odd and even signs they are reversed. The junction of the <s>nakṣatras</s> is at the end of the <s>Moon's</s> sign, <s>Scorpio</s>, and <s>Pisces</s>.
<s>Kriya</s>, <s>Tāvuri</s>, <s>Jituma</s>, <s>Kulīra</s>, <s>Leya</s>, <s>Pāthona</s>, <s>Jūka</s>, <s>Kaurpya</s> are the names;
<s>Taukṣika</s>, <s>Ākokero</s>, <s>Hṛdroga</s>, and the last sign — thus in this way.
The designations <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s>, <s>Horā</s>, <s>Navabhāga</s>, <s>Triṃśāṃśaka</s>, and <s>Dvādaśa</s>
are divisions; if a planet occupies any of these, it becomes that planet's <s>varga</s>. <s>Horā</s> means the <s>lagna</s> (ascendant) and also half of a sign.
<s>Taurus</s>, <s>Aries</s>, <s>Leo</s>, <s>Cancer</s>, and <s>Gemini</s>, along with <s>Capricorn</s> — these are called nocturnal; the same without <s>Gemini</s> rise from behind.
The rest rise head-first and are strong by day. Meeting the <s>lagna</s>, both sides have broad pairs of hair.

Cruel, gentle, male, female — they are movable, fixed, and dual-bodied; the lords of the cardinal directions beginning with east are <s>Aries</s>, <s>Taurus</s>, <s>Gemini</s>, and <s>Cancer</s>, with trines;
the <s>Horās</s> of the <s>Sun</s> and <s>Moon</s> are in odd and even signs respectively; the <s>Dreṣkāṇas</s> belong to the lords of one's own sign, the fifth, and the ninth house with trines.
Some, however, assign the first <s>Horā</s> to the sign-lord and the second to the lord of the eleventh;
they also describe the <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s> designation as belonging to the lords of one's own, the twelfth, and the eleventh signs.
<s>Aries</s>, <s>Taurus</s>, <s>Capricorn</s>, <s>Virgo</s>, and <s>Cancer</s>; <s>Pisces</s> and <s>Libra</s> are the exaltation signs beginning with the <s>Sun</s>;
at degrees ten, three, twenty-eight, fifteen, five, and twenty-seven respectively — and at the opposite of those are their debilitations.
The best <s>vargas</s> in movable signs beginning from the start, middle, and end are the <s>Navāṃśas</s> (ninth divisions) that give auspicious results;
<s>Leo</s>, <s>Taurus</s>, the first, sixth, <s>Sagittarius</s>, <s>Libra</s>, and <s>Aquarius</s> are the trine-houses, beginning from the <s>Sun</s>.
From <s>Horā</s> onward: body, family, co-born, relatives, children, enemies, spouse, death, fortune, livelihood,
the twelfth called <s>riḥpha</s> — these are <s>upacayas</s> (increasing houses); the enemy, tenth, eleventh — some say the houses called <s>duścikya</s> are not always so.
<s>Kalpa</s>, own, valor, home, intelligence, wound,

mind-born, death-aperture, teacher, honor, being, and loss — from the <s>lagna</s>, the fourth and eighth are called <s>caturastra</s> (square); the seventh house is <s>dyūna</s> (setting); the tenth sign is <s>ājñā</s> (command).
The designations <s>kaṇṭaka</s>, <s>kendra</s>, and <s>catuṣṭaya</s> refer to the seventh, first, fourth, and tenth signs;
in those houses as described, the powerful ones are aquatic creatures, humans, animals, and insects.
Next after the <s>kendra</s> is <s>paṇaphara</s>; after that, <s>āpoklima</s> — all signs. <s>Hibuka</s> means water, happiness, and house;
<s>jāmitra</s> is the seventh house; <s>trikoṇa</s> is the trine; <s>meṣūraṇa</s> is the tenth — and there one should know <s>karma</s> (action).

The <s>Horā</s> lord, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Mercury</s> — when aspected or conjoined by these and not by others, they are mighty in strength; when situated in <s>kendras</s>, bipeds and the rest prevail during day, night, and both twilights;

in the first half, objects of enjoyment and the rest are endowed with good qualities; honor and its opposite; the twelfth, the third, the ninth as asceticism, and the first three as trines — that too.
Red, white, parrot-green, pink, smoke-colored, pale, variegated, black, gold-like, tawny, mottled,
and brown, clear — these are the colors in the first house onward. Aquatic nature, the lord, and direction; from the sign joined with the <s>Sun</s>, the second is also the residence.

Time itself is the <s>Sun</s>; the <s>Moon</s> is mind; <s>Mars</s> is courage; <s>Mercury</s> is speech; <s>Jupiter</s> is knowledge and happiness; <s>Venus</s> is desire; pain is the son of the <s>Sun</s> (<s>Saturn</s>).

The <s>Sun</s> and <s>Moon</s> are kings; <s>Mars</s> is the commander; <s>Mercury</s> is the prince; <s>Jupiter</s> is the minister; the one honored by <s>Dānavas</s> (<s>Venus</s>) is also a minister; <s>Saturn</s> is the servant.
<s>Heli</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>; the <s>Moon</s>, <s>Śītaraśmi</s> (cold-rayed); <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Hemno-vij-jña</s>, <s>Bodhana</s>, and son of the <s>Moon</s>;
<s>Mars</s> — <s>Āra</s>, <s>Vakra</s>, <s>Krūradṛk</s>, and <s>Avaneya</s>; <s>Saturn</s> — <s>Koṇa</s>, <s>Manda</s>, <s>Sūryaputra</s>, and <s>Asita</s>;
<s>Jupiter</s> — <s>Aṅgiras</s>, <s>Suraguru</s>, <s>Vacasāmpati</s>, <s>Ījya</s>; <s>Venus</s> — <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Bhṛgusuta</s>, <s>Sita</s>, <s>Āsphujit</s>;
<s>Rāhu</s> — <s>Tamogur</s>, <s>Asura</s>; and <s>Ketu</s> is called <s>Śikhī</s>. One should also state other synonyms as known from common usage.
The <s>Sun</s> is red-dark; the <s>Moon</s> is fair; <s>Mars</s>, not very tall, is reddish-fair;
<s>Mercury</s> is grass-green; <s>Jupiter</s> has a fair body; <s>Venus</s> is dark; the <s>Sun's</s> son (<s>Saturn</s>) has a black body.

The colors are copper, white, very red, green, mixed yellow, variegated, and black. Their presiding deities in order from the <s>Sun</s> are <s>Agni</s>, water-born, <s>Keśava</s>, <s>Indra</s>, and <s>Śacī</s>'s lord.

In the cardinal directions beginning with east, the planets in order are: <s>Sun</s>, <s>Venus</s>, <s>Mars</s>, <s>Rāhu</s>, <s>Saturn</s>, <s>Moon</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, and <s>Jupiter</s>. The <s>waning Moon</s>, <s>Sun</s>, <s>Mars</s>, and <s>Saturn</s> are malefic; <s>Mercury</s> becomes malefic when joined with them.
<s>Mercury</s> and <s>Saturn</s> are called neuter; the <s>Moon</s> and <s>Venus</s> are female; the rest are male.
<s>Mars</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Venus</s>, and <s>Saturn</s> in order rule over the elements of fire, earth, space, water, and wind.
From <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> onward: <s>Venus</s> and <s>Jupiter</s>; <s>Mars</s> and <s>Sun</s>; the <s>Moon</s> and <s>Mercury</s> — thus for the castes down to the lowest.

The <s>Moon</s>, <s>Sun</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>; <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Venus</s>; <s>Mars</s>, <s>Saturn</s> — respectively represent <s>sattva</s> (goodness), <s>rajas</s> (passion), and <s>tamas</s> (darkness).
The <s>Sun</s> has honey-tawny eyes, a square body, a bilious constitution, and scanty hair.
The <s>Moon</s> has a slender round body, much wind-phlegm constitution, is wise, and has gentle speech and an auspicious gaze.
<s>Mars</s> has a cruel gaze, a youthful form, is generous, of bilious temperament, very fickle, with a slender waist.
<s>Mercury</s> has pleasant speech, is always inclined to humor, and has a constitution of bile, wind, and phlegm.
<s>Jupiter</s> (<s>Bṛhaspati</s>) has a large body, tawny hair and eyes, is of the highest intellect, and has a phlegmatic constitution.
<s>Venus</s> (<s>Bhṛgu</s>) is happy, has a beautiful body, fine eyes, dark curly hair, and a constitution of phlegm and wind.
<s>Saturn</s> is lazy, has tawny eyes, a lean and tall body, large teeth, coarse body-hair, and a windy constitution.
Sinew, bone, blood, skin, semen, fat, and marrow — belong to <s>Saturn</s>, <s>Sun</s>, <s>Moon</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Venus</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, and <s>Mars</s> respectively.
Temples, water, fire-houses, treasury, bedroom, earth, and rubbish-heap — these are their domains in order. Cloth is coarse, unused, fire-burnt, medium, firm, or split.

Copper, gems with gold, alloy, silver, and from the <s>Sun</s> also pearl and iron. Through the <s>Dreṣkāṇas</s>, the seasons beginning with <s>Śiśira</s> (late winter) arise when the <s>Moon</s>, <s>Venus</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, and the rest are ascendant.
The trines, the fourth house, the square, and the seventh — they aspect with increasing strength according to their quarters;
<s>Saturn</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, and <s>Mars</s>, and the others — they are respectively stronger in aspecting.
Half-year, moment, day, seasons, month, half-month, and year — these belong to the <s>Sun</s> onward.
Pungent, salty, bitter, mixed, sweet, sour, and astringent — these are the tastes.

<s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Moon</s>-<s>Mercury</s>, <s>Venus</s>-<s>Moon</s>-<s>Mercury</s>, <s>Sun</s>-<s>Mars</s>, <s>Moon</s>-<s>Sun</s>, <s>Mars</s>-<s>Moon</s>-<s>Sun</s> — these are the friends in order; some hold this view.

Truly speaking, friends are determined from the trine house and one's own sign: the lords of the own, last, third, tenth, and eleventh are friends; the lords of own exaltation, ninth, and fortune houses — there is no enmity from others' own characteristics.

<s>Saturn</s> and <s>Venus</s> are the <s>Sun's</s> enemies; <s>Mercury</s> is neutral; the rest are friends. The sharp-rayed one (<s>Mars</s>) and the son of the cold-rayed one (<s>Mercury</s>) are friends; the rest are neutral to the <s>Moon</s>.

<s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Moon</s>, and <s>Sun</s> are friends of <s>Mars</s>; <s>Mercury</s> is its enemy; <s>Venus</s> and <s>Saturn</s> are neutral. For <s>Mercury</s>: the <s>Sun</s> and <s>Venus</s> are friends; the <s>Moon</s> is enemy; the rest are neutral.

<s>Jupiter</s> is gentle; <s>Venus</s> and <s>Saturn</s> are enemies of the <s>Sun's</s> son; <s>Mercury</s> is neutral, but others say otherwise. <s>Mercury</s> and <s>Saturn</s> are friends; <s>Mars</s> and <s>Jupiter</s> are neutral for <s>Venus</s>; the rest are enemies.

<s>Venus</s> and <s>Mercury</s> are friends; <s>Jupiter</s> is neutral for <s>Saturn</s>; the others are enemies. Those declared as being in their own trines and sign and the rest are the ones I have stated.
Those situated in the second, twelfth, eleventh, third, tenth, and fourth from each other — they are friends at that time; in one's own exaltation sign also some say; but enemies otherwise.

Considering the natural friends, neutrals, and enemies of two, one, and the unmentioned sign-lords, and then again those at that time — one should determine them as great friends, friends, and so forth.
Positional strength comes from one's own exaltation, friend's sign, own trine, <s>Navāṃśa</s>, and from occupying one's own house.
In the directions, <s>Mercury</s> and <s>Jupiter</s>; <s>Sun</s> and <s>Mars</s>; <s>Saturn</s>; <s>Venus</s> and the <s>Moon</s>.
In the northern solstice, the <s>Sun</s>, <s>Moon</s>, and <s>Mars</s>; those approaching conjunction with <s>Mars</s> are the remainder.
Those with abundant rays and stationed in the north in battle are to be considered endowed with motional strength.
At night the <s>Moon</s>, <s>Mars</s>, and <s>Saturn</s>; <s>Mercury</s> always; by day the others. In the dark and bright fortnights, the malefics and benefics are strong respectively.

Temporal strength is through the half-year, day, <s>Horā</s>, and month lords. The <s>Moon</s>, <s>Mars</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Venus</s> and the rest are powerful in increasing strength.
When powerful malefic planets and weak benefic planets occupy the <s>kendras</s> while the <s>lagna</s> is in a eunuch sign, or through their aspect,
one should predict a being whose form corresponds to the <s>Navāṃśa</s> and <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s> occupied by the <s>Moon</s> — if that is the case, such a one is designated as of non-human birth.
When malefics are strong and in their own divisions, and benefics are weak and in another's division,
and the <s>lagna</s> is designated as non-human — seeing this too, one should predict a non-human birth.
<s>Aries</s> represents the head; <s>Mars</s> the neck; <s>Taurus</s> the others; the foot-division, back, chest, and sides;
the belly, lower parts, feet, and the genitals; buttocks and tail — thus he describes the limbs of a quadruped.
From the <s>lagna</s> degree, by the conjunction and aspect of planets, one should predict the colors with strength in the two-fold birth.
By aspect one should predict equal markings; by their own number, lines; and by those in the <s>Smara</s> position, markings on the back.
When a planet endowed with strength is in a bird <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s> or joined with a movable sign degree rising,
or in a <s>Mercury</s> division — then birds, whether land or aquatic, are born through the conjunction and aspect of <s>Saturn</s> and the <s>Moon</s>.
Through <s>Horā</s>, <s>Moon</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, and <s>Sun</s> being weak, the distinction of trees is made by water, land, and tree-division.
From the <s>lagna</s>, however many planets are the lords of land and water signs — that many trees are born on land or in water.
The <s>Sun</s> produces trees with hard inner wood; the <s>Sun's</s> son (<s>Saturn</s>) produces unfortunate ones; the <s>Moon</s> produces milky ones; and <s>Mars</s> produces thorny ones;
<s>Jupiter</s> and <s>Mercury</s> produce fruit-bearing and fruitless ones; <s>Venus</s> produces flowering trees; the <s>Moon</s> produces smooth ones; and <s>Mars</s> again produces pungent trees.
A benefic in a benefic sign produces a fine tree on good soil; the opposite otherwise.
By as many degrees as a planet has departed from its own division into another's, that many trees of that kind are born.
<s>Kuja</s> (Mars) and the Moon are the cause of the monthly menstruation. When the cool-rayed one (Moon) has gone to a sign of affliction,
when situated otherwise and aspected by benefic male planets, the amorous woman enters into union with a man.
As the setting sign (seventh house) meets its partner, so should the sexual union be declared;
when the seventh house is aspected and conjoined by malefic planets, [the union is] with anger and forced desire; [when benefics aspect,] with playful laughter.
When the Sun, Moon, <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), and Mars are in their own divisions, or when <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) is placed in a trine or the ascendant,
offspring is born; for those without seed (impotent), these [planets] are fruitless, like the rays of the Moon for the blind.
<s>Kuja</s> (Mars) and <s>Arkaja</s> (Saturn) in the seventh from the Sun and Moon give disease to men and women respectively;
placed in the twelfth and their own signs, they cause death; when conjoined and mutually aspecting, they are destined to bring death.
By day, the Sun and Venus are designated as father and mother; <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn) and the Moon at night, by reversal of this;
and those two are designated as paternal uncle and maternal aunt; when in odd and even signs respectively, they are auspicious for them.
When the ascendant sign is [occupied by] malefics desiring it and not receiving benefic aspect, death ensues;
and when <s>Yama</s> (Saturn) is conjoined with the ascendant sign, the woman [suffers], aspected by the waning Moon and Mars.
When the ascendant and Moon are situated between two malefics and not aspected by benefics,
one should declare that the pregnant woman perishes — either together [with the child] or separately.
When a malefic is in the fourth from the Moon, or when <s>Kuja</s> (Mars) occupies the eighth from the ascendant,
with the waning Moon in the fourth or twelfth, death [occurs] as before.
When Mars and the Sun are in the ascendant and seventh, one should predict death by weapons likewise;
when the lord of the month is afflicted, one should predict miscarriage at that time.
With benefic planets near the Moon and ascendant, placed in trines, the seventh, second, and fourth houses,
and malefics in the third and eleventh houses, the fetus is happy when aspected by the Sun.

In odd signs and masculine divisions, when the ascendant, Sun, <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter), and Moon are strong, one should predict male birth; when those same [planets] are in equal divisions in even signs, a female;

<s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) and the Sun in odd signs [predict] a male; Moon, Venus, and Mars in even signs [predict] a female; and <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) placed in a dual sign, aspecting, produces twins in its respective half.
Excepting the ascendant, <s>Saura</s> (Saturn) placed in an odd sign also produces male birth from the ascendant;
having examined the strength of the stated planets, one should declare whether the birth will be male or female.
If the Moon and Sun mutually aspect each other; if <s>Arkī</s> (Saturn) and Mercury [do likewise]; or if Mars is conjoined with the Sun; if the Moon and ascendant are situated in odd [signs];
also when the Moon and Mercury are in even and odd signs aspected by Mars — with Venus, the ascendant, and the Moon in the masculine position: these six are remembered as the yogas for eunuch birth.
When Moon and Venus are in even signs, and Mercury, Mars, Jupiter are in odd signs as the ascendant; or when the ascendant and Moon aspected by male planets are in even signs,

they produce twins. When Mercury in its own division in the ascendant aspects dual-sign divisions, triplets [are born]; by virtue of Mercury's division, twins [are born]; but with unmixed [planets], the same.
When the ascendant is in the last portion of Sagittarius, with strong planets situated in its divisions,
aspected by Mercury and Saturn endowed with strength, there are indeed many [children born] within the caul.

The stages [of embryonic development] — <s>kalala</s> (fluid), dense mass, sprout, bone, skin, hair, and consciousness — are [governed by] Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Sun, Moon, Saturn, and Mercury successively;
the lords of each month are declared to be the ascendant lord, Moon, and Sun in sequence; the auspiciousness or inauspiciousness [of each month] corresponds to the lord of that month.
When Mercury is in a trine with weak and other [planets], [the child] will have doubled face, feet, or hands;
with the Moon in Taurus facing downward and malefics at the junctions of signs, if aspected by benefics, [the child] speaks after a long delay.
When Saturn and Mars are in a benefic sign and division, [the child is] born with teeth; [the child is] hunchbacked when the Moon is in its own sign in the ascendant, aspected by Saturn and Mars;
lame when Pisces is in the ascendant aspected by Saturn, Moon, and Mars; and when the Moon is at a junction with a malefic, [the child] is dull, unless aspected by a benefic.
When aspected by Saturn, Moon, and Sun, [the child is] a dwarf when Capricorn or the last [sign] is the ascendant;
and with malefic-conjoined <s>drekkāṇas</s> (decans) in the ninth and ascendant, [the child] would be without arms, feet, or head.
When Leo is the ascendant conjoined with the Sun and Moon and aspected by Mars and Saturn, [the child is] without eyes; with [a mix of] benefics and malefics, having bubble-like eyes;
the Moon in the twelfth house injures the left [eye], the Sun the other; these yogas declared as inauspicious become tolerable when aspected by benefics.
That <s>dvādaśāṃśa</s> (twelfth division) which is conjoined with the Moon at that time, in a sign equal to that when the Moon is at the front,
however much of the equal portion of day and night has risen, when that much time has elapsed of day or night, they declare the birth.
If conception occurs when a soft (benefic) sign-division is rising and Saturn is in the seventh, birth takes place after three years;
but with the Moon, this rule may produce [birth] in the twelfth year; what has been stated here should be considered by reasoning at the time of birth as well.
One born when the father is absent — [this occurs when] the ascendant does not aspect the Moon;
[the father is] in a foreign land when [the ascendant is] in a movable sign, with the Sun fallen from the midheaven.
Or when Saturn is in the ascendant, or when Mars has set (reached the seventh),
or when the lord of the night (Moon) is situated between Mercury and Venus.
When the Moon [is afflicted], or with a malefic in the ascendant, or when the lord of Scorpio (Mars) is in a trine,
[the child] born with benefics in their own places is born [enveloped like] a serpent, or is wrapped by one.
When the Sun is in a quadruped sign, with the remaining [planets] endowed with strength,
and with [planets] in dual-bodied signs, twins are born enclosed in a membrane (caul).
When the ascendant is Aries, Leo, or Taurus, with Saturn or Mars situated therein,
[the child] is born wrapped in a cord on the body part corresponding to that sign and division.
When <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) does not aspect the ascendant and Moon, or the Moon is not conjoined with the Sun,
and the Moon is with a malefic or conjoined with the Sun — they certainly declare [the child to be] born from another [woman, i.e., not the birth mother].
When two malefics are in cruel signs, situated in the seventh, ninth, and fifth from the Sun,
the father is imprisoned or in a foreign land, or in his own [place] or on the road, according to the nature of the sign.
When the full Moon is in its own sign, a benefic Mercury is in the ascendant in the fourth house of happiness,
with a water sign as the ascendant or the Moon in the seventh, [the mother] gives birth while on a boat.
When the Moon is in a water sign and the ascendant is a water sign, and the full Moon aspects, or alternatively,
when [the relevant planets are] in Aries, a water sign, or the fourth house and the ascendant, the birth is in water, without doubt.
When the twelfth from the ascendant and Moon is occupied, and the fourth house is aspected by malefics, with Saturn [involved],
when Saturn conjoined with Scorpio or Cancer is in the ascendant and aspected by the Moon, [the birth is] under a banyan tree.
When Saturn in a water sign is in the ascendant, aspected by Mercury, Sun, and Moon respectively,
[the mother] gives birth in a playground, a temple, and on elevated ground respectively.
When Mars aspects a human sign in the ascendant, [the birth is] at a cremation ground; when Venus and Moon [aspect], in a pleasant place; when <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) [aspects], at a fire-altar;
the Sun [causes] birth in royal or divine households; <s>Budha</s> (Mercury) in an artisan's workshop.
When the sign and division correspond in their movement, birth [occurs] on the road if in a movable sign, in a house if in a fixed sign;
when in its own sign and division, [birth is] in one's own home; the result depends on the strength of the division and sign.
When the Moon is in a trine to Mars and Saturn and also in the seventh, [the child] is abandoned by its mother;
when aspected by <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter, counselor of the king of gods), that [child] is said to enjoy long life and happiness.
When the Moon aspected by malefics is in the ascendant and Mars is in the seventh, the abandoned [child] perishes; likewise when Mars and Saturn are in the eleventh;
when a benefic also aspects, [the child] comes into the hands of such a person; but when in another's hands through malefics, it is short-lived.
[Birth is] in the houses of father or mother according to their (planets') strength; in tree-groves and the like when [planets are] in debilitation; auspicious [otherwise];
if the ascendant and Moon are not aspected by any planet in sole occupation, [the mother] gives birth in a desolate place.

When the Moon is in Saturn's sign and division in the fourth house, or aspected by Saturn in a water sign, or conjoined with it, [the birth is] in darkness on a bed; with [planets] in debilitation, on the ground;
as the sign rises on the horizon, so does the delivery proceed; malefics in the seventh and fourth from the Moon indicate suffering for the mother.
The oil [of the lamp at birth] is indicated by the Moon, the wick by the ascendant, the lamp by the nature of the sign conjoined with the Sun — movable and so forth;
and the door of that dwelling should be known from the planets situated in the angles or endowed with strength.
Old and renovated [house] when Saturn [rules]; burnt and new when Mars [rules]; when the Moon [rules], wooden and not sturdy; when Mercury [rules], of manifold craftsmanship, beautiful,

multicolored and new when Venus [rules]; when Jupiter [rules], the house is strong; and from the planets situated in the houses, one should declare the arrangement as instructed, beginning from the direction.
With Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Scorpio [ascendants], [the dwelling faces] the northeast; in the houses of Jupiter and Mercury,
with Taurus, the dwelling is to the west; Capricorn and Leo indicate the southern direction.
In the house facing east and so on, Aries and so forth [are the signs]; the dual-bodied signs are placed two by two at the corners;
for beds also, one should declare as for the dwelling, with the feet [direction] determined by the sixth, third, ninth, and twelfth houses.
The attendants at birth are [indicated by] the planets situated between the Moon and the ascendant;
in the outer or inner half of the chart, visible or invisible respectively, [and] otherwise [indicated] by other [planets].
The body resembles the nature of the lord of the <s>navāṃśa</s> (ninth division) of the ascendant, or the physique matches the planet endowed with strength;
the complexion is that of the lord of the <s>navāṃśa</s> conjoined with the Moon; the body parts are distributed among the signs beginning from the ascendant.
Head, eyes, ears, nose, cheeks, jaws, and mouth correspond to the <s>horās</s> (half-signs) beginning [from the ascendant]; then throat, shoulders, arms, sides, heart, and chest; then the navel;
bladder, genitals, and anus; then the testicles; thighs; then knees; calves and feet — on both sides, the left is indicated by the rising <s>drekkāṇas</s> (decans), divided threefold.

In that [body part], when conjoined with a malefic, one should predict a wound; when conjoined with or aspected by a benefic, an [auspicious] mark; in its own sign and division with fixed signs, it is innate; otherwise, acquired;

from Saturn, [the wound is] caused by stone and wind; from Mars, by fire, weapons, and poison; from Mercury, by [falling on] the ground; from the Sun, by wood or a quadruped; from the Moon, by a horned or aquatic animal; from the others, it is auspicious.
In whichever body part three planets including Mercury have converged, there is certainly acquisition [of a mark] — whether from benefics or malefics;
a malefic produces a wound in the sixth house on the body part corresponding to that sign; one repeatedly aspected by and conjoined with benefics has auspicious marks.
At twilight, during the <s>horā</s> (half-sign) of the Moon, with malefics at the ends of signs, [the child is destined] for death;
with the Moon conjoined with malefics in the twelfth or in the angles, that [child] meets destruction.
When malefics are in the eastern and western halves of the chart and benefics [are absent], with Scorpio as the ascendant,
the one born quickly meets destruction; also when malefics flank both sides of the ascendant and seventh house.
When two malefics are in the ascendant and seventh, and the Moon is conjoined with a malefic,
and not aspected by benefics, death occurs shortly.
When the waning Moon is in the twelfth, with malefics in the ascendant and eighth,
and benefics are not in the angles, one should predict swift death.
When the Moon conjoined with a malefic is in the seventh, twelfth, eighth, or ascendant,
and benefics are outside the angles and [the Moon] is not aspected [by them], it gives death.

When the Moon is in the sixth or eighth and aspected by malefics, death is swift; when [aspected] by benefics, the <s>samāṣṭakavarga</s> portion [determines longevity]; and with mixed [aspects], survival;

when aspected by strong malefics, [the child lives but] a month; when the lord of the ascendant is conjoined with [the lord of] the seventh and overcome by malefics, [there is danger] in the benefic [period].
When the waning Moon is in the ascendant, with malefics in the eighth and angles; when the Moon surrounded by malefics is in the eighth, fourth, or seventh,
when the ascendant is thus with malefics in the seventh and eighth, [death occurs] together with the mother, if not aspected by powerful benefics.
When the Moon at the end of a sign is not aspected by benefics, and malefics occupy the trines,
the infant quickly departs from life; also when malefics are in the seventh and the Moon is in the ascendant.
When the eclipsed Moon is conjoined with a malefic and <s>Kuja</s> (Mars) occupies the eighth, death comes to both mother and child; when the Sun is in the ascendant, [death is] caused by weapons.

When the <s>Sun</s> rises [in the ascendant] or the <s>Moon</s> [is there], with malefics possessed of strength occupying the triangular and death-dealing houses, and not conjoined with or aspected by benefics, death [occurs]. (In <s>Hariṇī</s> meter)
By <s>Saturn</s>, the <s>Sun</s>, the <s>Moon</s>, and <s>Mars</s> occupying the twelfth, ninth, first, and eighth houses,
death of embodied beings occurs swiftly, if they are not aspected by a strong <s>Jupiter</s>. (In <s>Aparavaktra</s> meter)
The <s>Moon</s> conjoined with malefics in the fifth, seventh, ninth, twelfth, first, or eighth houses [causes] death,
if not conjoined with or aspected by strong <s>Venus</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, and <s>Jupiter</s>. (In <s>Puṣpitāgrā</s> meter)
When the <s>Moon</s>, being strong, has entered the place of the <s>yoga</s> or its own house or the ascendant,
and is aspected by malefics while powerful, death within the year is declared by the sages. (In <s>Bhramaravilasitā</s> meter)
By <s>Maya</s>, <s>Yavana</s>, <s>Maṇittha</s>, <s>Śakti</s>, and others, years have been assigned to the <s>Sun</s> and the other [planets],
as 19, 15, 5, 7, 5, 11, and 10 plus 10, [respectively,] when they are in their own or exaltation signs. (In <s>Puṣpitāgrā</s> meter)

In debilitation, half of that is reduced; and when placed in between [exaltation and debilitation], proportionally. Others say [the contribution is] equal to the <s>horā</s>, proportionate to the <s>navāṃśa</s>, or equal to the <s>rāśi</s>.

Excluding retrograde [planets], one-third is diminished by those placed in enemy signs; for those whose luster is eclipsed by the <s>Sun</s>, half [is lost], excepting <s>Venus</s> and <s>Saturn</s>. (In <s>Mandākrāntā</s> meter)
Fractions of the whole — one-half, one-third, three-quarters, one-fifth, and one-sixth — are diminished from the twelfth house; when malefics are to the left,
when benefics [are there], half is reduced; likewise for those in the same sign, one <s>navāṃśa</s> portion is taken away by the stronger — so says <s>Satya</s>. (In <s>Praharṣiṇī</s> meter)
From the total, [computed by] multiplying the risen and half-risen <s>navāṃśas</s>, one-eighth portion reaching the count of one hundred and eight meets destruction.
When a malefic is conjoined with the ascendant by this method, and aspected by benefics, half of that goes to dissolution. (In <s>Vasantatilakā</s> meter)
Sixty years doubled is the [maximum lifespan] for humans and elephants, plus five nights; for horses thirty-two; for donkeys and camels, five times five;
and that [lifespan] is irregular — for bulls and buffaloes twelve, for dogs it is remembered [as such], and for goats and the like, six plus ten is the maximum. (In <s>Śikhariṇī</s> meter)
When the ascendant is in the highest <s>navāṃśa</s> of <s>Pisces</s>, with <s>Saturn</s> [strong] in Capricorn, and [all planets] marked by the five-fold division,
then the maximum measure of longevity obtains, if all [planets] are combined in their own or exaltation signs. (In <s>Puṣpitāgrā</s> meter)
<s>Viṣṇugupta</s> also calculated <s>āyurdāya</s> in this very manner, as did <s>Devasvāmī</s> and <s>Siddhasena</s>.

And the fault of these [systems] arises: without setting aside the eight <s>ariṣṭas</s> (death-inflicting combinations), longevity should not be [calculated as] less than twenty. (In <s>Śālinī</s> meter)
In whichever <s>yoga</s> full longevity is indicated, in that [combination] others have declared the status of a universal emperor.
This defect is evident — another person also lives the full lifespan even without wealth. (In <s>Śālinī</s> meter)
<s>Jīvaśarman</s> states according to his own doctrine that the planetary contribution [to longevity] is a <s>svara-aṃśa</s> (twelfth part) of the maximum lifespan.
The <s>rāśi</s> corresponding to the <s>navāṃśa</s> traversed by the planet attains great agreement — [his] statement is true. (In <s>Upacchandasikā</s> meter)
According to <s>Satya</s>'s statement, having converted the desired planet into minutes of arc and divided by two hundred,
when the degrees of the circle are purified, the result gives years; from the remainder, months and so forth [are derived]. (In <s>Āryā</s> meter)
By those in their own exaltation or retrograde, the contribution is tripled; doubled for those in the best <s>varga</s>, own <s>navāṃśa</s>, sign, or <s>drekkāṇa</s>.
This much is the distinction in <s>Bhadatta</s>'s teaching; the rest is the same as stated in the first [system]. (In <s>Vaṃśastha</s> meter)
However, here [a planet] gives [a contribution] proportionate to the sign and <s>navāṃśa</s> when endowed with strength, and the <s>horā</s> gives an amount equal to the sign.

And when the ascendant has a malefic rising, the accumulation [of years] does not apply here; nor should [the calculation] be done with the years prescribed in the first [method]. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
The teaching of <s>Satya</s> is indeed excellent in this matter, but they make it unsuitable through excessive sub-divisions.
And in the proliferation of many multiplications, the teachership [becomes confused] — that which is singular yet comprehensive, that alone should be applied. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
When <s>Jupiter</s> and the <s>Moon</s> are conjoined in the Cancer ascendant, and <s>Saturn</s> and <s>Venus</s> have gone to the angular houses,
with the remaining [planets] in the eleventh, sixth, and third houses, longevity here would be immeasurable, without the [usual] sequential [calculation]. (In <s>Puṣpitāgrā</s> meter)

Those [planets] situated in the ascendant, [the houses of] the <s>Sun</s>, the <s>Moon</s>, the living beings [5th], and angular houses give their results in the first, middle, and last portions of life [respectively].

Indeed, the ripening of results does not fail to occur for one situated in an angular house or the first house; for one in an <s>āpoklima</s> (cadent house) also, the fruit ripens first. (In <s>Mālinī</s> meter)
The <s>daśā</s> is to be assigned to that very [planet] by which the longevity has been determined, and [it belongs] to the strongest first.
When there is equality among many, [priority goes] to the one granting the most years; and when they too are equal, to the one that rose first. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
One situated in the same sign takes half and then gives its own [share]; one in a trine house [gives] one-third; one in the seventh, a <s>svara-aṃśa</s> (twelfth);
one in a square [gives] a quarter of the result. One with a <s>horā</s> [relationship operates] thus — those mutually disposed ripen [each other's results]. (In <s>Vasantatilakā</s> meter)
Having described these positions otherwise, all [contributions] without division below,
the multipliers according to their shares in the ten-year aggregate, and the division by their sum — [that is how] the sub-division of <s>daśā</s> [is determined]. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
The <s>daśā</s> of one who is properly strong and in its own or exaltation sign is full [in results]; of one devoid of strength, it is empty;
of one placed in its debilitation <s>navāṃśa</s> or in an enemy's sign, the <s>daśā</s> is to be known as yielding unfavorable results at birth. (In <s>Vaitālīya</s> meter)
For one fallen from exaltation, the <s>daśā</s> is called 'descending' — it becomes middling when in a friend's or exalted sign.
For one departed from its lowest point, it is 'ascending'; in debilitation, enemy sign, or [enemy] <s>navāṃśa</s>, the <s>daśā</s> becomes the worst. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
For one situated in a debilitation or enemy <s>navāṃśa</s> but in a favorable sign, the <s>daśā</s> is declared to have mixed results.
I shall now describe the results corresponding to these designations in the <s>daśās</s>, as they apply. (In <s>Upajātikā</s> meter)
Both [types of <s>daśā</s>] are worst, middling, and best by the <s>drekkāṇas</s> in movable signs in reverse order;
unfavorable, favorable, and mixed in fixed signs in [direct] order — thus is the <s>daśā</s> of the <s>horā</s> determined. (In <s>Vaitālīya</s> meter)

One, two, nine, twenty, eighteen, twenty, fifty — these in order are the years of [the <s>daśā</s> of] <s>Moon</s>, <s>Mars</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Venus</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Sun</s>, and <s>Saturn</s> for humans and elephants.

Each [planet's <s>daśā</s>] nourishes results through its own created effects; at the end, the <s>daśā</s> of the ascendant is auspicious — so say the <s>Yavanas</s>, though some do not accept this. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

When the <s>daśā</s> lord is in the ascendant, or in a friendly <s>varga</s>, or in a benefic's [division], the commenced <s>daśā</s> gives auspicious [results]; also when the <s>daśā</s> lord is in the third, sixth, or eleventh.

When the <s>Moon</s> is situated in a friend's, exaltation, <s>upacaya</s>, trine, or seventh house of the <s>daśā</s> lord, it produces good results and awareness; otherwise, evil [results]. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

A <s>daśā</s> commenced when the <s>Moon</s> is in its own house brings honor, wealth, and happiness; in <s>Mars</s>'s house, it corrupts the wife; in <s>Mercury</s>'s house, it bestows learning, friends, and wealth.

In <s>Leo</s>, it brings activity in fortresses, forests, roads, and dwellings, and agriculture; in <s>Venus</s>'s sign, it gives food; in Capricorn and Aquarius, it gives bad women; in <s>Jupiter</s>'s house, it brings honor, wealth, and happiness. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)
In the <s>Sun</s>'s [<s>daśā</s>]: [gains from] dogs, nails, teeth, hides, gold, cruelty, journeys, and kings in battle; sharpness, courage, constant effort and delight, fame, valor, and eminence.

[Also] calamities arising from wife, sons, wealth, enemies, weapons, fire, and kings; one becomes generous, devoted to sinful deeds, quarrelsome with one's own servants, and afflicted with diseases of the chest and stomach. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)
Having attained the <s>daśā</s> of the <s>Moon</s>, one obtains results through mantras, Brahmins, sugarcane, milk products, cloth, flowers, play, sesame, food, and labor.

Sleep, laziness, softness, devotion to Brahmins and gods, birth of a daughter, intelligence, rise and decline of fame and wealth through the powerful, and enmity with one's own faction. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

In the <s>daśā</s> of <s>Mars</s>: wealth through destruction of enemies, kings, brothers, land, sheep, and goats; enmity with sons, friends, wife, and brothers; hostility toward the learned and elders.

Diseases caused by thirst, blood, fever, bile, and fractures; [troubles] caused by other men's wives; delight in those devoted to sin, devotion to unrighteousness, harshness and sharpness. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

In the <s>daśā</s> of <s>Mercury</s>: wealth through ambassadorship, friends, teachers, and Brahmins; praise of the learned, fame, skill in reasoning, gold, mules, land, good fortune, happiness, and attainments.

Skill in humor and worship, increase of intellect, success in religious acts, harshness, toil, imprisonment, mental grief, and affliction from the three <s>doṣas</s> (bodily humors). (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

In the <s>daśā</s> of <s>Jupiter</s>: rise of honor and virtue, increase of intellect, radiance, valor and eminence, greatness, effort, wealth through counsel, statecraft, kings, and sacred study and mantras.

Accumulation of gold, horses, sons, elephants, and garments; friendship with virtuous kings; subtle reasoning, resort to deep hermitages, ear disease, and enmity with those following heterodox paths. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)
In the <s>daśā</s> of <s>Venus</s>: delight in song, joy, fragrant substances, food, drink, garments, women, gems, splendor, instruments of love, knowledge, and arrival of desired friends.

Skill in buying and selling, agriculture, discovery of treasures, acquisition of wealth; enmity with leaders of groups, lords of the earth, and lowly people devoid of dharma; grief from affection. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

Having attained <s>Saturn</s>'s [<s>daśā</s>]: acquisition of donkeys, camels, birds, buffaloes, and old women; honor produced through guilds, villages, and city governance; acquisition of inferior grains.

One experiences phlegm, jealousy, wind-disorders, anger, delusion, impurity, calamity, lethargy, and weariness; also reproach of servants, children, and wife, and [one] attains deformity. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)
In auspicious <s>daśās</s>, [planets] produce good results; those with the designation 'unfavorable' [produce] their own auspicious [results diminished] in the same way.
In mixed [<s>daśās</s>], the results of the <s>daśā</s> are mixed; the result of the <s>horā</s> equals that of the lord of the ascendant. (In <s>Upajātikā</s> meter)
Whatever substance has been assigned to each [planet] in the chapter on designations, and whatever occupation and livelihood has been taught for each,
and whatever arises from the house, position, aspect, and <s>yoga</s> — all of that is to be applied to the respective planet's <s>daśā</s>. (In <s>Śālinī</s> meter)
All [planets], upon attaining their own <s>daśā</s>, manifest the shadow composed of the five great elements,
and the qualities born of water, fire, wind, and space, to be inferred from the nose, mouth, eyes, skin, and ears [respectively]. (In <s>Indravajrā</s> meter)
The <s>antardaśā</s> within an auspicious-result-giving <s>daśā</s> is of the same nature; it produces much friendship and acquisition of wealth for people.

One should infer the current [<s>antardaśā</s>] from the described ripening of results; the attainment of fruit matures through dreams, thoughts, and the [planet's] own strength. (In <s>Mālinī</s> meter)
When there is conflict between two results of a single planet, one should predict destruction — whichever is stronger, that ripens.
No other planet destroys the similar result of another; [planets] that have entered their own respective <s>daśā</s> will be productive of their [own] results. (In <s>Vasantatilakā</s> meter)

The <s>Sun</s> [gives benefic dots] from itself in the 1st, 11th, 4th, 8th, 2nd, 10th, 9th, and 7th; from <s>Mars</s>, from itself likewise and the same; from <s>Saturn</s>, from <s>Venus</s> in the 7th, 12th, and 6th;

from <s>Jupiter</s> in the 9th, 5th, 11th, and 6th houses; [<s>Saturn</s> gives benefic dots] in the 10th, 3rd, 11th, and 6th from the <s>Moon</s>; in these same [houses] plus the 12th, 9th, and 5th from <s>Mercury</s>; and from the ascendant, [the Sun gives dots] in its own, 4th, and 12th. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

The <s>Moon</s> [gives benefic dots] from the ascendant in the 6th, 3rd, 10th, and 11th, and in the 2nd, 9th, and 9th houses; from <s>Mars</s> in the same, 8th and onwards; in the same, 8th, and 7th from the <s>Sun</s>; in the 6th, 3rd, 11th, and 9th from <s>Saturn</s>;

in the 9th, 3rd, 11th, 8th, and angular houses from <s>Mercury</s>; from <s>Jupiter</s> in the 12th, 11th, and 8th; and in the angular houses; from <s>Venus</s> in the 9th, 4th, 9th, 3rd, 11th, and houses of livelihood and the 7th. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

<s>Mars</s> [gives benefic dots] in the <s>upacaya</s> houses from the <s>Sun</s>; with the 5th from the first and above from the ascendant; from the <s>Moon</s> in the directional and fruitless houses, angular, 8th, acquisition, and 2nd; from itself, [it is] auspicious.

In the 9th, 11th, 8th, and angular houses from <s>Saturn</s>; from <s>Mercury</s> in the 6th, 3rd, 9th, and 11th; from <s>Venus</s> in the 6th, 12th, 11th, and 8th; from <s>Jupiter</s> in the 10th, other than the 11th, and 6th. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

<s>Mercury</s> [gives benefic dots] from <s>Venus</s> in the 2nd, 1st, 11th, 8th, 9th, and 4th; with the 3rd and 5th from <s>Moon</s>; in [its] own, 10th, and 7th houses from <s>Saturn</s>; in the 12th, 6th, acquisition, and 8th from <s>Jupiter</s>.

In the 9th, 11th, 6th, 5th, and 12th from the <s>Sun</s>; from itself in its own, 1st, 10th, and 3rd; in the 6th, its own, 11th, 8th, 4th, and [house of] livelihood from the <s>Moon</s>; in its own and 1st from the ascendant, [it is] auspicious. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

<s>Jupiter</s> [gives benefic dots] from <s>Mars</s> in the directional, its own, 1st, 8th, 11th, and 4th; from itself in the trines; from the <s>Sun</s> in [its] own, 3rd, and 9th; in the 9th, its own, 9th, directional, 11th, and 6th from <s>Venus</s>;

in the 7th, 11th, 10th, 9th, and 5th from the <s>Moon</s>; from <s>Saturn</s> in the 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th; in the directional, 9th, 6th, its own, 4th, 11th, 1st, and 9th from <s>Mercury</s>; and with the 7th from the ascendant. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)

<s>Venus</s> [gives benefic dots] from the ascendant in the 1st through 5th, 11th, 8th, and 9th; with the 12th from the <s>Moon</s>; from itself in its own and 10th houses; in the 4th, 3rd, 9th, 9th, 10th, 8th, and acquisition from <s>Saturn</s>;

in the 8th, 11th, and 12th from the <s>Sun</s>; in the 9th, 10th, acquisition, 8th, and 9th from <s>Jupiter</s>; from <s>Mercury</s> in the 9th, 3rd, 11th, 9th, and 6th; in the 3rd, 9th, 6th, 5th, 11th, with the 12th from <s>Mars</s>. (In <s>Śārdūlavikrīḍita</s> meter)
The <s>Moon</s> visible during the day produces inauspicious results, with a wasting body; when otherwise, it is auspicious — the rest should be inferred.
From the <s>lagna</s>, one is exceedingly wealthy; from the <s>Moon</s>, wealthy — when all benefic planets occupy the <s>upacaya</s> (increasing) houses;
with two, one is moderate; with fewer, of little wealth — and when they are absent, even in results this should be understood with emphasis.

The <s>Sun</s> joined with the <s>Moon</s> produces a person who works with machinery and stone; with <s>Mars</s>, one who is unrighteous; with <s>Mercury</s>, one who is skilled, endowed with intelligence, fame, and happiness;

with <s>Jupiter</s>, one who is cruel, engaged in others' affairs; with <s>Venus</s>, one who earns wealth through the stage and weapons; with <s>Saturn</s>, one skilled in metals, or in various kinds of merchandise.

The <s>Moon</s> with <s>Mars</s> produces one who deals in illicit liquor, pots, and trade, and is inauspicious for the mother; with <s>Mercury</s>, one of humble speech, skilled in wealth, endowed with fortune and fame;

with <s>Jupiter</s>, one who is valiant, chief of the family, unsteady of mind, and lord of wealth; with <s>Venus</s>, one skilled in crafts and such activities; with <s>Saturn</s>, a son of a remarried woman.

<s>Mars</s> with <s>Mercury</s> produces a trader who deals in roots, oils, and deceptions, and a warrior by arm-strength; with <s>Jupiter</s>, he becomes a city-chief, a king, one who has obtained wealth, or a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>;

with <s>Venus</s>, a cowherd, a wrestler, then a skillful one, devoted to others' wives, a gambler; with <s>Saturn</s> and <s>Jupiter</s>, one afflicted with sorrow, untruthful in agreements; with the son of the <s>Sun</s> (<s>Saturn</s>) and <s>Mars</s>, one who is censured.

<s>Mercury</s> with <s>Venus</s> makes a stage-performer; joined with <s>Jupiter</s>, one fond of song and skilled in dance, eloquent, a leader of the earth; with gentle <s>Venus</s>, one clever in illusion and a leaper;

when <s>Jupiter</s> is joined with <s>Venus</s>, one possessed of good learning, wealth, and wife, and of many virtues; with <s>Saturn</s>, one should know him as a barber, a pot-maker, or one born as a cook.
In the conjunction of <s>Saturn</s> and <s>Venus</s>, one has defective eyesight, increased wealth through association with women,
and becomes a knower of writing, manuscripts, and painting — the results described should be further varied from the combinations stated above.

When four or more powerful planets occupy a single house, born separately with their own strengths, the persons become <s>Śākya</s> (Buddhist), <s>Ājīvika</s>, <s>Bhikṣu</s> (mendicant), <s>Vṛddha</s> (elder ascetic), <s>Caraka</s> (wandering ascetic), <s>Nirgrantha</s> (Jain), and forest-eaters respectively,

through <s>Mars</s>, <s>Mercury</s>, <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Moon</s>, <s>Venus</s>, and <s>Sun</s> in order. When the strongest of these dominate, the renunciation is of that type; when they are defeated by their own lords, there is a fall from the order.
Those whose initiation is concealed by the rays of the <s>Sun</s> are uninitiated, but are devoted to that planet's deity when strong;
they are initiated merely by begging, and even when afflicted or aspected by others, they remain so.
If the lord of the birth-sign is unaspected by others but <s>Saturn</s> aspects it, or <s>Saturn</s> aspects the birth-lord when it is weak in strength,
one obtains initiation; when <s>Saturn's</s> <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s> is occupied and <s>Mars</s> is in <s>Saturn's</s> <s>Navāṃśa</s>, and the <s>Moon</s> is aspected by <s>Saturn</s>,

when in the ninth house the <s>Horās</s> of <s>Jupiter</s>, <s>Moon</s>, and <s>Sun</s> are aspected in the <s>dharma</s> (ninth) house, <s>Jupiter</s> then born in the combination of kings becomes a <s>tīrthakṛt</s> (founder of a religious order);
when <s>Saturn</s> occupies the ninth house and is aspected by others, in the combination for royalty, the sovereign becomes an initiated king.
One born under <s>Aśvinī</s> is fond of ornaments, handsome, fortunate, skillful, and intelligent;
under <s>Bharaṇī</s>, one is resolute, truthful, healthy, skillful, and happy.
Under <s>Kṛttikā</s>, one eats much, is fond of others' wives, brilliant, and famous;
under <s>Rohiṇī</s>, one is truthful, pure, sweet-spoken, of steady mind, and handsome.
Under <s>Mṛgaśīrṣa</s>, one is fickle, clever, timid, eloquent, enterprising, wealthy, and pleasure-loving;
under <s>Ārdrā</s>, one is deceitful, proud, ungrateful, violent, and sinful.
Under <s>Punarvasu</s>, one is self-restrained, happy, of good character, dull-witted, afflicted with disease, and thirsty,
and contented with little — such a person is born under <s>Punarvasu</s>.
Under <s>Puṣya</s>, one is of peaceful nature, fortunate, learned, wealthy, and devoted to <s>dharma</s>;
under <s>Āśleṣā</s>, one is deceitful, eats everything, sinful, ungrateful, and treacherous.
Under <s>Maghā</s>, one has many servants, is wealthy, pleasure-loving, devoted to gods and ancestors, and of great enterprise;
under <s>Pūrva-Phālgunī</s>, one is sweet-spoken, generous, radiant, a wanderer, and a servant of kings.
Under <s>Uttara-Phālgunī</s>, one is fortunate, wealthy through learning, pleasure-loving, and happy;
under <s>Hasta</s>, one is enterprising, bold, fond of drinking, compassionate, and a thief.
Under <s>Citrā</s>, one wears colorful garments and garlands, and has beautiful eyes and limbs;
under <s>Svātī</s>, one is self-restrained, a merchant, compassionate, sweet-spoken, and devoted to <s>dharma</s>.
Under <s>Viśākhā</s>, one is jealous, greedy, brilliant, skillful in speech, and quarrelsome;
under <s>Anurādhā</s>, one is wealthy, dwells in foreign lands, hungry, and a wanderer.
Under <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, one has few friends, is contented, righteous, but of much anger;
under <s>Mūla</s>, one is proud, wealthy, happy, non-violent, steady, and pleasure-loving.
Under <s>Pūrva-Āṣāḍhā</s>, one has a beloved, joyful spouse, is proud, and of firm friendship;
under <s>Uttara-Āṣāḍhā</s>, one is modest, righteous, having many friends, grateful, and fortunate.
Under <s>Śravaṇa</s>, one is prosperous, learned, of noble wife, wealthy, and famous;
under <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>, one is generous, wealthy, brave, fond of song, but greedy for wealth.
Under <s>Śatabhiṣaj</s>, one is bold in speech, addicted to vices, destroyer of enemies, daring, and hard to restrain;
under <s>Pūrva-Bhādrapadā</s>, one has two groups, is conquered by women, wealthy, clever, but ungenerous.
Under <s>Uttara-Bhādrapadā</s>, one is eloquent, happy, blessed with progeny, victorious over enemies, and righteous;
under <s>Revatī</s>, one has complete limbs, is fortunate, brave, pure, and wealthy.

One born with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Aries</s> has round, coppery eyes, eats hot, vegetable, and light food, is quick to be pleased, a wanderer, amorous, with weak knees, of unstable wealth, brave, and dear to women,
knows service, has nail-marks, has veins marked with scars, is proud, has an elder brother born together, is marked on the palm with authority, is very fickle, and extremely afraid of water.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Taurus</s> is handsome, has a playful gait, broad thighs and face, is marked on the back, face, and sides, is generous, endures hardship, is lordly, has a prominent hump, has daughters as offspring, and is phlegmatic;
bereft of earlier kinsmen, wealth, and sons, endowed with good fortune, patient, with strong digestive fire, fond of women, with steadfast friends, happy in middle and later life.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Gemini</s> is fond of women, skilled in the arts of love, has coppery eyes, knows the <s>śāstras</s>, is a messenger, has curly hair, sharp intellect, knows humor, gestures, and gambling,
has beautiful limbs, pleasant speech, is radiant for a moment, fond of song, skilled in dance, has intercourse with eunuchs, has a prominent nose — when the <s>Moon</s> is in the third sign.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Cancer</s> walks with a slightly crooked but swift gait, has raised hips, is conquered by women, has good friends, is an astrologer, and is endowed with many houses, losses, and wealth like the <s>Moon</s>;

is short, has a thick neck, and is united with family through conciliatory means, is affectionate to friends, fond of water and gardens, born in one's own house — such is a person born under the sign of the <s>Moon</s>.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Leo</s> is sharp, has a large jaw, broad face, tawny eyes, few children, hates women, is fond of meat and forests and mountains, is angry for a long time over improper matters,
is afflicted by hunger, thirst, stomach, teeth, and mental ailments, is generous, valiant, of steady intellect, proud-minded, and obedient to the mother — when in the sign of the <s>Sun</s>.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Virgo</s> has a modest, slow, and charming gaze and gait, has drooping shoulders and arms, is happy, gentle, devoted to truth, skilled in the arts, knowledgeable in the meaning of <s>śāstras</s>, righteous,
intelligent, fond of love-making, and obtains others' houses and wealth; when in <s>Virgo</s>, one dwells in foreign lands, has pleasant speech, has daughters as offspring, and few sons.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Libra</s> is devoted to the worship of gods, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, and holy persons, is wise, pure, conquered by women, tall, with a prominent nose, lean, with trembling limbs, a wanderer, and possessed of wealth;
has defective limbs, is skilled in buying and selling, has two names with 'god', is diseased, helps kinsmen but is hated by them and abandoned by them — when in the seventh sign.
One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Scorpio</s> has broad eyes, chest, round calves, thighs, and knees, is separated from father and teacher in childhood, and is afflicted with disease;
is honored by royal families, is tawny, of cruel conduct, has marks of fish, thunderbolt, and bird on the body, conceals sins — such is one born under <s>Scorpio</s>.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Sagittarius</s> has a disproportionately long face and neck, inherits paternal wealth, is generous, a poet, and valiant, an orator, has large teeth, ears, lips, and nose, is devoted to work, and skilled in crafts,

has a hunchbacked portion, has bad nails, has equal shoulders and arms, is bold, knows <s>dharma</s>, hates kinsmen, does not submit by force but by conciliatory means alone — such is one born under the sign of the Bow.

One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Capricorn</s> always cherishes one's own wife and children, bears the banner of <s>dharma</s>, is lean in the lower body, has fine eyes, a thin waist, follows advice given, is endowed with good fortune, and is lazy,

sensitive to cold, a wanderer; in <s>Capricorn</s>, the person has an excess of <s>sattva</s> (goodness), composes poetry, is greedy, devoted to forbidden and old women, has abandoned shame and compassion.
One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Aquarius</s> has a camel-like neck, prominent veins, rough body-hair, a long body, broad feet, thighs, back, buttocks, face, and waist, and is aged in appearance;

devoted to sinful deeds involving others' wives and wealth, subject to increase and decrease of fortune, fond of flowers, perfumes, and friends — such is one born under <s>Aquarius</s>, enduring on the road.
One with the <s>Moon</s> in <s>Pisces</s> enjoys water and others' wealth, is attached to fine clothes and home, has an even and beautiful body, a prominent nose, and a large frame;
overcomes co-wives, is conquered by women, has charming eyes, is a treasure of splendor, wealthy, pleasure-loving, and learned — when in the last sign.
When the zodiac sign and its lord are strong, and the <s>Moon</s> is endowed with its own strength,
one grants the full measure of the qualities described; like the <s>Moon</s>, the others should be considered in the same manner.
One is famous, clever, a wanderer, of little wealth when the <s>Sun</s> is in <s>Aries</s>; but when in the raised portion, he bears weapons;
in <s>Taurus</s>, one lives by trade in cloth, perfumes, and merchandise, is a connoisseur of women, and skilled in cattle and grain.

When the <s>Sun</s> is in <s>Gemini</s>, one has knowledge of learning, astrology, and wealth; when in <s>Cancer</s>, one is sharp, lacking horses, engaged in others' work, and is beset with toil, journey, and hardship;

when in <s>Leo</s>, one is fond of forests, mountains, and cattle-herds, endowed with valor but ignorant; when in <s>Virgo</s>, one is endowed with knowledge of writing, manuscripts, poetry, mathematics, and has a feminine body.

One born with the <s>Sun</s> in <s>Libra</s> is a distiller, fond of travel, a goldsmith, of base conduct; when in <s>Scorpio</s>, one is cruel, daring, earns wealth through poison, and meets one's end through weapons;

when in <s>Sagittarius</s>, one is honored by the virtuous, wealthy, sharp, a physician or artisan; when in <s>Capricorn</s>, one is base, ignorant, a petty trader, of little wealth, one who has risen through the fortune of others, and devoted to pleasures.
In <s>Aquarius</s>, one is base, bereft of children and fortune, lacking horses, with wealth derived from water-born merchandise; in <s>Pisces</s>, one is devoted to women;
in the division resembling the <s>nakṣatra</s>, human, and body forms, one should predict marks and signs — when joined with the <s>Moon</s> and the <s>Sun</s>.
When <s>Mars</s> is in its own sign, one is honored by the king, a wanderer, an army-commander, a merchant with wealth, of wounded body, a thief, and of many dominions;
when <s>Venus</s> is in its own sign, it produces those conquered by women, hostile among friends, devoted to others' wives, deceitful, well-dressed, timid, and lacking manliness.
In <s>Mercury's</s> sign, one is without daring, has children, lacks friends, is grateful, skilled in music and combat, miserly, fearless, and acquisitive;
in the <s>Moon's</s> sign, one is wealthy, has earned possessions through water-travel; wise; and in <s>Mars's</s> sign, one is defective and wicked.

When <s>Mars</s> is in <s>Leo</s>, one is destitute, endures hardship, wanders in forests, and has few wives and sons; in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign, one has many enemies, is a minister of kings, famous, fearless, but with few sons;

when <s>Mars</s> is in <s>Aquarius</s>, one is afflicted with sorrow, without wealth, a wanderer, addicted to falsehood, and sharp; when in <s>Capricorn</s>, one has abundant wealth and children, and is a king or equal to one.
In <s>Mars's</s> own sign, people are addicted to gambling, debt, and drinking, atheistic, thieves, destitute, involved with bad women, fraudulent, and devoted to falsehood;
in <s>Venus's</s> sign, they are devoted to teachers, blessed with many children, wives, and wealth, fond of acquiring; in <s>Mercury's</s> sign, they are eloquent, devoted to the worship of elders.
In the third sign (<s>Gemini</s>), one is boastful, skilled in <s>śāstras</s> and arts, sweet-spoken, and devoted to pleasures;
in the <s>Moon's</s> sign, one earns wealth through water, and is an enemy of one's own people — when joined with the cold-rayed one's (<s>Moon's</s>) sign.
When <s>Mercury</s> is in the <s>Sun's</s> sign, one hates women, is without wealth, happiness, and children, a wanderer, ignorant, fond of women, and humiliated by one's own people;
in the sixth sign (<s>Virgo</s>), one is generous, wise, of many virtues, happy, patient, skilled in reasoning, and free from fear.
When <s>Mercury</s> is in <s>Saturn's</s> sign, one does others' work, lacks horses, craftsmanship, and intelligence, is indebted, and does forced labor;
in the ninth sign (<s>Sagittarius</s>), one is honored by kings, learned, and of trustworthy speech; in the last sign (<s>Pisces</s>), one is conquered by servants and of menial skill.

When born in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign on <s>Mars's</s> sign, one has an army, little wealth, few wives and children, is generous, has good servants, is patient, endowed with splendor, wifely virtues, and is famous.

In <s>Venus's</s> sign, one has complete limbs, wealth, purpose, friends, and children, is generous and beloved; in <s>Mercury's</s> sign, one has abundant possessions, children, and friends, is endowed with ministerial office, and is happy.

In the <s>Moon's</s> sign, one is endowed with gems, children, own wife, wealth, wisdom, and happiness; in <s>Leo</s>, one becomes a commander of forces; and in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign, what was stated for the <s>Moon's</s> sign applies;

in its own sign, one is a provincial governor, a minister of kings, or a general, and wealthy; in <s>Aquarius</s>, the results are as for <s>Cancer</s>; in <s>Capricorn</s>, one is base, of little wealth, and unhappy.
In <s>Mars's</s> sign, one is devoted to others' wives, has wealth taken away through disputes over such matters, and is a disgrace to the family;
in its own sign, <s>Venus</s> produces one who is self-reliant in strength, intellect, and wealth, honored by kings, a lord among one's own people, famous, and fearless.
When <s>Venus</s> is in <s>Gemini</s>, one performs royal duties, is wealthy, and skilled in arts; when in the sixth sign, one is of extremely base conduct;
when in <s>Saturn's</s> sign, one is honored by gods and enemies of gods, fortunate, conquered by women, and devoted to low-born women.
In the <s>Moon's</s> sign, one has two wives, is acquisitive, timid, with strong pride and sorrow; in <s>Mars's</s> sign, a woman obtains wealth, is an excellent young woman, but has few children;
in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign with horses, one is honored for virtues and has a sister; in <s>Pisces</s>, one is learned, wealthy, honored by royalty, and exceedingly fortunate.
In <s>Saturn's</s> sign and <s>Aries</s>, one is foolish, a wanderer, deceitful, and friendless; in <s>Scorpio</s>, one suffers bondage and killing, is fickle and without compassion;
shameless, with happiness, wealth, and children, but prone to stumbling in writing; in <s>Mercury's</s> sign, one becomes a chief of guards and a leader of the community.

When <s>Saturn</s> is in <s>Taurus</s>, one is fond of forbidden women, of not much wealth, having many wives; when in its exaltation, one is famous, honored by communities, cities, and armies, and wealthy; in <s>Cancer</s>, one lacks horses, has defective teeth, is bereft of mother and children, and is ignorant; in <s>Leo</s>, the son of the <s>Sun</s> (<s>Saturn</s>) makes one ignoble, without happiness and children, and a performer of forced labor.

When <s>Saturn</s> is in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign, one is self-confident, trusted by the royal household, with good children, wife, and wealth; when the son of the <s>Sun</s> is in <s>Jupiter's</s> sign, one becomes a leader of cities, armies, and villages, or

is supported by others' wives and wealth, and becomes a leader of cities, armies, and villages, with dull eyesight; in its own sign, one is impure, of stable wealth and possessions, and an enjoyer — such is the person born.
The results of the conjunction with the <s>Moon</s> and its aspect are declared to produce similar effects at the <s>lagna</s>;
this result is greater than what was stated from the house, and should be considered with the qualities of the lord of the house and sign.

When the <s>Moon</s> is in <s>Aries</s>, one is a king; with <s>Mercury</s>, one has kingly qualities; a thief, poor; destitute, thief, honored by people, a king, and wealthy; a servant — through <s>Mars</s> and the others in <s>Taurus</s>;
in <s>Leo</s>, one deals in iron, is a king, wise, a weaver, poor; in its own sign, a warrior, poet, wise one, and kings, one who lives by iron, and those with eye-diseases;

through <s>Mercury</s> and the others in <s>Scorpio</s>, an astrologer, wealthy person, king, barber, and eyelash-lord; likewise kings, army-commanders, and those endowed with skill; in the sixth sign with malefics, one depends on women;
in <s>Libra</s>, a king, goldsmith, and merchant; when aspected by the rest, a cheat; in <s>Scorpio</s>, one with two fathers, an actor, a washerman, one with deformed limbs, poor, and a king;

in <s>Sagittarius</s>, one depends on kinsmen, kings, and people, and with malefics, is always watery and deceitful; very much a king, lord of kings, learned, and wealthy, but lacking in resources; in <s>Capricorn</s>, a king;
a king or equal to a king, devoted to others' wives, and with the rest in <s>Aquarius</s>; in <s>Pisces</s>, one knows humor, is a king and wise, and with a malefic aspect, is sinful.

The <s>Moon</s> situated in the sign of the <s>Horā</s> lord, aspected by benefics, produces good results; in the <s>Dreṣkāṇa</s>, aspected by the lords of those divisions, or by those occupying friend's houses, it is commended;

what was stated as the result per sign and aspect is to be understood in the <s>Dvādaśāṃśa</s> (twelfth-division); and when the <s>Moon</s> is aspected by the rising planets of the <s>Sun</s>, it should be known through the <s>Navāṃśas</s>.
When the <s>Moon</s> is in the <s>Navāṃśa</s> of <s>Mars</s>, one is a guard, fond of killing, and skilled in combat; a king, wealthy, and quarrelsome;
when in <s>Venus's</s> <s>Navāṃśa</s>, foolish, devoted to others' wives; in good poetry, a composer of excellent poetry, devoted to pleasures, and having another's wife.
In <s>Mercury's</s> <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is a stage-performer, thief, chief poet, minister, knower of song, and skilled in crafts — when the <s>Moon</s> is so situated;
in its own <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one has a small body, is greedy for wealth, chief among ascetics, a lord of women, and devoted to improper acts — as seen through aspect.
In the <s>Navāṃśa</s> of <s>Leo</s>, one is wrathful, esteemed by kings, a lord of treasures, lordly, without sons, and of extremely violent deeds;
in <s>Jupiter's</s> <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is of renowned strength, an instructor in battle, knows humor, and has the character of a minister's beloved elder.
With few children, unhappy even when possessing one's own, attached to honor, devoted to one's own work,
fond of wicked women, and miserly — when in <s>Saturn's</s> <s>Navāṃśa</s>; when the <s>Moon</s> is with the <s>Sun</s>, the results are similar when aspected by the <s>Moon</s> and others.
What has been stated as auspicious in the highest <s>varga</s> (division), one's own and others' signs — that becomes full, moderate, slight, or fruitless in descending order;
the lord of the <s>Navāṃśa</s> endowed with strength overrides the earlier sign-result and gives the <s>Navāṃśa</s> result.

When the <s>Sun</s> is in the first house (<s>lagna</s>), one is brave, obstinate, with defective eyes, and without compassion; in <s>Aries</s>, one has possessions; with clouded vision when in <s>Leo</s>; when in its debilitation sign, blind;
when in the <s>Moon's</s> house (<s>Cancer</s>), having bubble-like eyes; in the second house, one has abundant wealth, wealth seized by the king, diseases of the body, and crookedness.
When the <s>Sun</s> is in the third house, one has intelligence and valor; unhappy, with injured pride when in the fourth;
without sons and bereft of wealth when in a trine; powerful but conquered by enemies when in the sixth house.
When the <s>Sun</s> is in the seventh house, one suffers humiliation through women, has few sons; when in the eighth house, one has defective eyesight;
in the ninth house, one has sons, wealth, and happiness; in the tenth, one has happiness and valor; in the eleventh, one has abundant wealth; in the twelfth, one falls.

When the <s>Moon</s> rises at the <s>lagna</s>, one is mute, insane, dull, blind, defective, deaf, or a servant; when in its own sign or exaltation, one is wealthy with many sons and possessions; when in the second house, one is a householder;
violent when in the third house; in the fourth, one has children and the results stated for that house; in the sixth, one has many enemies, a soft body, fiery passion, is sharp and lazy.

Jealous, with intense pride when in the seventh, of many opinions, afflicted with disease in the eighth; blessed with fortune, children, friends, kinsmen, and wealth when the <s>Moon</s> is in the ninth house;

one achieves success endowed with <s>dharma</s>, wealth, intelligence, and valor when in the tenth; one is famous and endowed with the qualities of the house when in the eleventh; one is petty and defective in limbs when in the twelfth.
When <s>Mars</s> is in the <s>lagna</s>, one has a wounded body; in the second house, one eats bad food; in the ninth, one is sinful; when situated elsewhere, one is equal to the <s>Sun</s>;
when <s>Mercury</s> is like the <s>Sun</s>, one is learned, wealthy, an eminent scholar, a minister, without enemies, known for <s>dharma</s>-knowledge and renowned virtues.
When <s>Jupiter</s> is in the <s>lagna</s> and onward in sequence: learned, eloquent, miserly, happy,
an enemy of intelligence and honor, greater than one's father, base, an ascetic, wealthy, gainful, and wicked.
When <s>Venus</s> is in the <s>lagna</s>, one is skilled in love and happy; in the seventh house, quarrelsome with the beloved and desirous of love-making;
in the fifth house, one is happy; the son of <s>Bhṛgu</s> (<s>Venus</s>) gives wealth when in another's house in the twelfth, speaking like <s>Jupiter</s>.
When <s>Saturn</s> is in the <s>lagna</s>, one has unseen wealth, is diseased, subject to passion, extremely impure, afflicted with pain in childhood, and of lazy speech;

when <s>Jupiter</s> is in its own sign or exaltation, one is like a king, a leader of villages and cities, very learned, with beautiful limbs; when elsewhere, the results are said to be like the <s>Sun</s>.
The results of planets situated in friend's, enemy's, another's, own, and exaltation signs should be considered through the <s>lagna</s>, body, and other houses;
in <s>upacaya</s> (increasing) and <s>vipatti</s> (calamitous) houses, benefic and malefic planets speak truly; the opposite occurs in the twelfth, sixth, and eighth houses.
Through planets situated in exaltation, trine, own, friend's, enemy's, and debilitation signs,
the auspicious results are full, three-quarters, half, one-quarter, slight, or fruitless respectively.
Through the progressive increase of planets in their own signs, one is of good family, a family-chief, honored by kinsmen, wealthy, happy, pleasure-loving, and a king;
through planets in friend's signs, one is supported by others' wealth and friends, nourishes one's own kinsmen, and becomes a community-leader, army-chief, and king.
Even a single planet in exaltation, aspected by a friend, produces a king endowed with abundant wealth, and through the combination of friends, success;
when in enemy's and debilitation signs, one is without wealth, unhappy, deluded, diseased, afflicted with bondage, beset with killing and sin.
<s>Satya</s> (the sage) says that <s>Aquarius</s> <s>lagna</s> is not auspicious; the <s>Yavanas</s> (Greeks) say that through division of portions, it is not so;
for which sign is there no such division of portions? — but this would lead to over-extension, says <s>Viṣṇugupta</s>.
When planets have gone to bad, own, or equal signs, one born in the <s>Sun's</s> <s>Horā</s> is famous, of great enterprise, endowed with strength, wealth, and brilliant splendor;
when born in the <s>Moon's</s> <s>Horā</s> with benefics in even signs, one is endowed with softness, beauty, happiness, good fortune, intelligence, and sweet speech.
In those very <s>Horās</s>, when planets are in their own or others' signs, the persons should be known as middling in the first group;
when situated in houses with reversed <s>Horās</s>, people become devoid of the stated qualities.
When the <s>Moon</s> is in a trine to the <s>lagna</s> of the self and friends, it produces qualities of its own and the qualities of the lord of that sign;
in serpent, animal, weapon, quadruped, and egg-born <s>Dreṣkāṇas</s>, one is sharp, extremely violent, devoted to the elder's bed, and a wanderer.
A thief, an enjoyer, a scholar, wealthy, a king, a eunuch, a hero, a forced-laborer, one of servile occupation,
sinful, violent, and fearless — in the highest <s>varga</s> <s>Navāṃśas</s>; the lordship of these is like the sign, through the twelve divisions.
When <s>Mars</s> is in its own <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is accompanied by a wife, endowed with strength, ornaments, and courage, and possessed of splendor and great daring;
when <s>Saturn</s> is in its own <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is diseased, whose wife has died, hostile, having another's wife, unhappy, endowed with possessions, and impure.
When <s>Jupiter</s> is in its own <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is endowed with wealth, fame, happiness, and intelligence, brilliant, honored, healthy, enterprising, and pleasure-loving;
when <s>Mercury</s> is in its own <s>Navāṃśa</s>, one is endowed with intelligence, arts, textiles, poetry, debate, crafts, knowledge of <s>śāstras</s>, enterprise, and is greatly honored.

When <s>Venus</s> is in its own <s>Triṃśāṃśa</s> (thirtieth-division), one has many sons, happiness, health, fortune, wealth, and beauty; in <s>Venus's</s> division, one is sharp, with a beautiful elegant body, and with widely scattered senses;

the brave and obstinate pair are hostile and murderous, endowed with good qualities, wealthy, and happy — these eight results apply to the <s>Navāṃśas</s> of <s>Sun</s> and <s>Moon</s> joined with those beginning from <s>Mars</s>.
Those planets situated in their own sign, exaltation, <s>mūlatrikoṇa</s>, and trine, and occupying <s>kendras</s> (angular houses),
all of them are mutual <s>kārakas</s> (significators) of one another; but the one occupying the tenth house is especially so.
For example, when the <s>Moon</s> rises in <s>Cancer</s>, and <s>Mars</s>, <s>Saturn</s>, <s>Sun</s>, and <s>Jupiter</s> are in their own exaltations,
they are declared to be mutual <s>kārakas</s>; for the planet in the <s>lagna</s>, the entire sky and water become its domain.
When a planet in its own trine or exaltation is the cause, if it occupies the tenth house,
it is a friend endowed with those qualities, and is also called a <s>kāraka</s> (significator).
Birth is auspicious when in the highest <s>varga</s>, in the <s>Veśi</s> position, and in a good house,
when the <s>kendras</s> are not empty, and the planets are those called <s>kārakas</s>.
Planets in <s>kendras</s>, the lords of <s>Jupiter</s>, birth, and <s>lagna</s> give happiness in the middle of life;
those in fixed and dual signs at the <s>lagna</s> give results at the end; those in movable signs give results at the beginning.
At the time of entering a house, the <s>Sun</s> and <s>Mars</s> are at the entrance; <s>Jupiter</s> and <s>Venus</s> are in the middle of the house;
<s>Saturn</s> and the <s>Moon</s> are at the exit; the son of the <s>Moon</s> (<s>Mercury</s>) gives results at all times.

When the lord of the benefic sign reaches the fifth or seventh house from the <s>lagna</s>, or is aspected, or from the <s>Moon</s> — if there is prosperity for both, it should be known; otherwise, the result is the opposite;

when the <s>Sun</s> rises with less than a full <s>pāda</s> (quarter), and <s>Saturn</s> is situated in <s>Pisces</s>, it destroys the wife; and when situated in the fifth house, it gives death of children — the son of the earth (<s>Mars</s>) gives this.
